1.w: In freedom Christ set us free. Stand firm, therefore, and do not be entangled again in a yoke of slavery.

2.w: Behold, I, Paul, say to you⁺ that if you⁺ may become circumcised, Christ will profit you⁺ nothing.

3.w: Now I testify again to every man becoming circumcised that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

4.w: You⁺ were severed from Christ, whoever are being justified in the law; you⁺ fell away from grace.

5.w: For through the Spirit, by faith, we eagerly await the hope of righteousness.

6.w: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision has any power, but faith working through love.

7.w: You⁺ were running well. Who obstructed you⁺ not to obey the truth?

8.w: [This] persuasion [is] not of the One calling you⁺.

9.w: A little leaven leavens the whole lump.

10.w: I am confident as to you⁺ in the Lord that you⁺ will have no other mind. But the one troubling you⁺ will bear the judgment, whoever he might be.

11.w: Now, brothers, if I still proclaim circumcision, why still am I persecuted? Then the offense of the cross has been nullified.

12.w: I wish those upsetting you⁺ also will cut themselves off!

13.w: For you⁺ were called to freedom, brothers, only not the freedom for an opportunity to the flesh. But serve one another through love.

14.w: For all the law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

15.w: But if you⁺ bite and devour one another, watch out, lest you⁺ might be consumed by one another.

16.w: Now I say, walk by the Spirit, and you⁺ shall never complete the desire [of] the flesh.

17.w: For the flesh desires against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh. For these are opposed to one another so that the [things] you⁺ may want, these things you⁺ may not do.

18.w: But if you⁺ are led by the Spirit, you⁺ are not under the law.

19.w: Now the works of the flesh are manifest, which are sexual immorality, impurity, sensuality,

20.w: idolatry, sorcery, hostilities, strife, jealousy, outbursts of rage, rivalries, dissensions, factions,

21.w: envies, drunkennesses, carousings, and things like these, as to which I say to you⁺ beforehand, as also I said before, that those doing such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.

22.w: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness,

23.w: gentleness, self-control. Against such things there is no law.

24.w: Now those of Christ Jesus crucified the flesh with the passions and the desires.

25.w: If we live by the Spirit, we should also walk by the Spirit.

26.w: We should not become conceited, provoking one another, envying one another.
